correctness.rationale: For every n>=2 uniform Dirichlet simplex coordinates, the conditional coordinate decomposition M_n=(1-X_1)Y_{n-1}+R_n yields n Cov(M_n,K_n(t))=1-eta_n(t)-(1-t)^(n-1)(1+nt H_{n-1}), eta=n² E[R_n 1_{X_1<=t}]. The exponential representation bounds eta by n²[(2/e)^n+exp(-n exp(-2nt))], which is o(1) at nt=loglog n+logloglog n+z; remaining product ->e^-z. Convexity of h_n(t)=E[M_n|X_1>t] gives unique interior zero and the profile brackets its two-log position. Independent rational small-dimensional identity and window-sign checks reproduce normalization; finite n is not an infinite proof.
